## Players
| Player | Sells | For | Price | In their words | Address |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Billfast | invoices | UK freelancers | £9 / month | "invoices in a minute" | https://billfast.example/pricing |
| LedgerPro | invoicing, payroll, VAT | small firms | £29 / month | "your whole back office" | https://ledgerpro.example/pricing |
| Quotient | quotes and invoices | agencies | not published | "built for agencies" | https://quotient.example |

## Clusters
- Freelancers under £10: Billfast.
- Accounting suites: LedgerPro.
- Agencies: Quotient (price not published).

## Gaps
- Invoices in more than one currency for freelancers: the comparison says none of the tools under £20 does it — https://compare.example/invoicing
